title: WISE Academy
lede: Short courses on how search engines and AI answer engines find, understand and rank content. Each one takes about half an hour and ends with a quiz and a completion badge.

tracks.name: Crawling
tracks.blurb: How search engines discover pages, and where crawlers waste their time.

tracks.name: Indexing and processing
tracks.blurb: What happens to a page after it is fetched: rendering, text processing, duplicates and languages.

tracks.name: Understanding queries
tracks.blurb: How a search engine works out what someone is asking for.

tracks.name: Retrieval
tracks.blurb: How a system pulls candidate pages out of its index, from exact keywords to vectors.

tracks.name: Ranking
tracks.blurb: How candidates are put in order: re-rankers, learned ranking, engagement and freshness.

tracks.name: Authority and quality
tracks.blurb: Links, topical depth, quality guidelines and the signals behind trust.

tracks.name: AI answers and search features
tracks.blurb: AI Overviews, featured snippets, blended results and the retrieval behind them.

tracks.name: Measuring search quality
tracks.blurb: How search and RAG systems are tested and scored.

tracks.name: Local SEO
tracks.blurb: How local results are ranked, and what a business can actually influence.

paths.name: SEO fundamentals
paths.audience: New to SEO, or onboarding to WISE
paths.blurb: The core ideas every SEO conversation comes back to: intent, crawling, indexing, structured data, links and quality.

paths.name: AI search and AEO
paths.audience: Optimising for AI Overviews and answer engines
paths.blurb: How AI search rewrites questions, picks passages and builds an answer, and what that means for content.

paths.name: Local SEO
paths.audience: Working on local and multi-location clients
paths.blurb: The complete local series, from how local results are ranked to local results in AI answers and maps.

paths.name: Search engineering
paths.audience: Technical SEOs and anyone building RAG
paths.blurb: How retrieval works under the hood: indexes, keyword weighting, vectors, hybrid search, re-ranking and evaluation.
